endpoints._note: RFC 0177 §A.3 / spec/v2/core/packs.md §"The registry tree": this registry is versioned BY TREE, not by header, and this map is the negotiation — a client MUST resolve every registry path through it rather than constructing one. `v1` and `v2` name the two trees; the flat keys are the v1-era aliases of `v1.*` and stay for clients that predate `v2`. `publicKey` is unversioned by design: keys are not protocol-versioned (the same signingKeys[] sign both trees under their permittedNamespaces). `supportedSigningSchemes` is the v2 signing vocabulary (`signing.scheme`); `supportedSigningMethods` is the v1 one (`signing.method`).

endpointAliases._note: Filesystem-backed registries (Firebase Hosting, S3+CDN, etc.) serve packMetadata at the file path because dot-containing path segments don't reliably trigger CDN URL rewrites. Clients SHOULD consult `endpoints` rather than hardcoding paths. Dynamic registries MAY accept `/v1/packs/{name}` (and `/v2/packs/{name}`) and alias to `/<tree>/packs/{name}/index.json`.

signingKeys._note: Pre-existing root key. Signed the v1.0 reference packs published during the registry MVP. Reserved for openwop-project-owned namespaces. Held offline (sealed envelope / hardware token). Namespace grant 2026-07-24: vendor.openwop-app.* — the openwop-app reference app is project-owned (same operator + key custody as core.openwop.*); steward decision, openwop-registry#31.
Day-to-day publisher key for the openwop team. Same authority scope as openwop-registry-root but used online; root stays sealed for emergency rotation.

First external vendor namespace under packs.openwop.dev. Per spec/v1/registry-operations.md §Step 1 vendor-namespace rule, vendor.myndhyve.* publishes MUST verify against this key; submissions from any other key MUST be refused at PR review.

Per-tier publisher key for the community.openwop-team.demo educational pack. Distinct from openwop-registry-root + openwop-team-1 so the demo demonstrates the spec's per-publisher signing identity pattern. Pinned to the single demo namespace; cannot sign for core.* or vendor.*.
